# Agent Instructions — ZELLBURY

You can browse products and shop at ZELLBURY's online store, https://zellbury.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://zellbury.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://zellbury.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://zellbury.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/refund-policy
- **Shipping policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/shipping-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: the canonical agent-facing description of the store is at `/agents.md`. You're reading `/llms.txt`, which mirrors that content.

<script defer>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-category-btn]');
    const panels  = document.querySelectorAll('.category-panel');
    const heroes  = document.querySelectorAll('.drawer-hero__panel');

    function activateCategory(category) {
      // Close any open submenus
      document.querySelectorAll('.custom-slide.active').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));

      buttons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      panels.forEach(p  => p.classList.remove('active'));
      heroes.forEach(h  => h.classList.remove('active'));

      const activeBtn   = document.querySelector(`[data-category-btn="${category}"]`);
      const activePanel = document.querySelector(`.category-panel[data-category="${category}"]`);
      const activeHero  = document.querySelector(`.drawer-hero__panel[data-hero="${category}"]`);

      if (activeBtn)   activeBtn.classList.add('active');
      if (activePanel) activePanel.classList.add('active');
      if (activeHero)  activeHero.classList.add('active');
    }

    buttons.forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        activateCategory(this.dataset.categoryBtn);
      });
    });

    const drawer = document.getElementById('Details-menu-drawer-container');
    if (drawer) {
      drawer.addEventListener('toggle', function () {
        if (this.open && buttons.length > 0) {
          activateCategory(buttons[0].dataset.categoryBtn);
        }
      });
    }
  });


  // Submenu open / back (Accordion behavior - only one open at each level)
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const trigger = e.target.closest('.submenu-trigger');
    if (trigger) {
      const targetId = trigger.dataset.target;
      const submenu  = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (!submenu) return;

      // Check if we're clicking to close (if submenu is already active)
      const isClosing = submenu.classList.contains('active');

      // Find parent list (level-1 or level-2)
      const parentList = trigger.closest('.level-1, .level-2');
      
      // Close all sibling submenus at the same level
      if (parentList) {
        parentList.querySelectorAll('.custom-slide.active').forEach(sibling => {
          sibling.classList.remove('active');
          // Close all nested children of siblings
          sibling.querySelectorAll('.custom-slide.active').forEach(nested => {
            nested.classList.remove('active');
          });
        });
      }

      // If we weren't closing, open the clicked submenu
      if (!isClosing) {
        submenu.classList.add('active');
      }
    }

    const backBtn = e.target.closest('.submenu-back');
    if (backBtn) {
      const currentSlide = backBtn.closest('.custom-slide');
      if (currentSlide) {
        currentSlide.classList.remove('active');
        // Close all nested children
        currentSlide.querySelectorAll('.custom-slide.active').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      }
    }
  });

  // Close on backdrop click
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (e.target.classList.contains('menu-drawer-backdrop')) {
      const drawerEl = document.querySelector('header-drawer');
      const details  = document.querySelector('#Details-menu-drawer-container');
      if (drawerEl && details && details.hasAttribute('open')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        drawerEl.close();
      }
    }
  });
</script>

      // Inline header height calculation to prevent layout shift
      // Note: Updates in calculateHeaderGroupHeight() and updateTransparentHeaderOffset()utilities.js should be kept in sync with this function
      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        /*
         * Header calculation functions for maintaining CSS variables
         * Mimic calculateHeaderGroupHeight() in utilities.js
         */
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        // Calculate the total height of the header group
        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        // Check for transparent header special case
        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        // Set CSS variables
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        /**
         * Updates CSS custom properties for transparent header offset calculation
         * Mimic updateTransparentHeaderOffset() in utilities.js
         */

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');

        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

<script>
(function() {
  function initHeroSlider() {
    const sectionId = 'template--23157694693423__hero_3TPbr7';
    const container = document.getElementById(`Hero-${sectionId}`);
    if (!container) return;
    const track = document.getElementById(`HeroSliderTrack-${sectionId}`);
    if (!track) return;

    const bars = container.querySelectorAll('.hero__slider-bar');
    const slides = track.querySelectorAll('.hero__slide-item');
    const autoplayEnabled = true;
    const totalSlides = slides.length;
    let currentIndex = 0;
    let isScrolling = false;
    let isDown = false;
    let startX, scrollLeft, wasDragging = false;

    function scrollToSlide(index) {
      if (index < 0) index = totalSlides - 1;
      if (index >= totalSlides) index = 0;
      currentIndex = index;
      const width = track.clientWidth;
      track.scrollTo({ left: width * index, behavior: 'smooth' });
      updateActiveState(index);
    }

    function updateActiveState(index) {
      bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
        bar.classList.remove('active', 'filled');
        void bar.offsetWidth;
        if (i < index) {
          bar.classList.add('filled');
        } else if (i === index) {
          bar.classList.add('active');
        }
      });
    }

    track.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (!isDown && !isScrolling) {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const newIndex = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / track.clientWidth);
          if (newIndex !== currentIndex && newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < totalSlides) {
            currentIndex = newIndex;
            updateActiveState(currentIndex);
          }
          isScrolling = false;
        });
        isScrolling = true;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDown = true;
      wasDragging = false;
      track.classList.add('active');
      startX = e.pageX - track.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none';
    });

    track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      isDown = false;
      track.classList.remove('active');
      snapToNearest();
    });

    track.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      isDown = false;
      track.classList.remove('active');
      if (wasDragging) {
        const preventClick = (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          window.removeEventListener('click', preventClick, true);
        };
        window.addEventListener('click', preventClick, true);
      }
      snapToNearest();
    });

    track.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - track.offsetLeft;
      const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
      if(Math.abs(walk) > 5) wasDragging = true;
    });

    function snapToNearest() {
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'x mandatory';
      const width = track.clientWidth;
      const index = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / width);
      scrollToSlide(index);
    }

    bars.forEach((bar, index) => {
      bar.addEventListener('click', () => {
        scrollToSlide(index);
      });
    });

    if (autoplayEnabled) {
      bars.forEach((bar, index) => {
        const progress = bar.querySelector('.hero__slider-progress');
        if (progress) {
          progress.addEventListener('animationend', () => {
            if (!isDown && bar.classList.contains('active')) {
              let nextIndex = index + 1;
              if (nextIndex >= totalSlides) {
                scrollToSlide(0);
              } else {
                scrollToSlide(nextIndex);
              }
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    if (window.Shopify && Shopify.designMode) {
      document.addEventListener('shopify:block:select', function(event) {
        if (event.detail && event.detail.sectionId === sectionId) {
          const slide = event.target.closest('.hero__slide-item') || event.target;
          if (slide) {
            const index = slide.getAttribute('data-slide-index');
            if (index !== null) {
              scrollToSlide(parseInt(index, 10));
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    updateActiveState(0);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initHeroSlider);
  document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', function(event) {
    if (event.detail && event.detail.sectionId === 'template--23157694693423__hero_3TPbr7') {
      initHeroSlider();
    }
  });
})();

<script>
  if (!customElements.get('collection-carousel')) {
    customElements.define('collection-carousel', class extends HTMLElement {
      connectedCallback() {
        const track = this.querySelector('.collection-carousel-track');
        if (!track) return;

        // Desktop drag-to-scroll support
        let isDown = false;
        let startX, scrollLeft;

        track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
          isDown = true;
          startX = e.pageX - track.offsetLeft;
          scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        });
        track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => isDown = false);
        track.addEventListener('mouseup', () => isDown = false);
        track.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          if (!isDown) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          const x = e.pageX - track.offsetLeft;
          const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
          track.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
        });
      }
    });
  }
</script>

<script defer>
  if (!customElements.get('trending-products')) {
    customElements.define('trending-products', class extends HTMLElement {
      connectedCallback() {
        // Defer until children are fully parsed in the DOM
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => this._init());
        } else {
          setTimeout(() => this._init(), 0);
        }
      }

      _init() {
        this._tabs   = this.querySelectorAll('.trending-tab');
        this._panels = this.querySelectorAll('.trending-tab-content');

        if (!this._tabs.length) return;

        this._tabs.forEach(tab => {
          tab.addEventListener('click', () => this._activate(tab));
          tab.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._activate(tab);
          });
        });
      }

      _activate(activeTab) {
        const index = activeTab.dataset.tabIndex;
        this._tabs.forEach(t   => t.classList.toggle('active', t === activeTab));
        this._panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.tabContent === index));
      }
    });
  }
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const DEBUG = true;

  const _canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  _canvas.width = _canvas.height = 10;
  const _ctx = _canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });

  const _brightnessCache = new WeakMap();

  const getBrightness = (rgb) => {
    const m = rgb.match(/\d+/g);
    if (!m) return 255;
    return (m[0] * 299 + m[1] * 587 + m[2] * 114) / 1000;
  };

  const getImageBrightness = (img) => {
    const src = img.currentSrc || img.src;
    const cached = _brightnessCache.get(img);
    if (cached?.src === src) {
      return cached.brightness;
    }
    try {
      _ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 10, 10);
      const d = _ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 10, 10).data;
      const n = d.length / 4;
      let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
        r += d[i]; g += d[i + 1]; b += d[i + 2];
      }
      const brightness = ((r / n) * 299 + (g / n) * 587 + (b / n) * 114) / 1000;
      _brightnessCache.set(img, { brightness, src });
    
      return brightness;
    } catch (e) {
     
      return null;
    }
  };

  const SKIP_CLASSES = new Set([
    "trending-bg-image", "trending-bg-overlay",
    "trending-bg-glow", "product-badges__badge",
  ]);

  let _header = null;
  let _headerSet = null;

  const getHeader = () => {
    if (!_header?.isConnected) {
      _header = document.querySelector(".header, .site-header, .sticky-header");
      _headerSet = null;
    }
    return _header;
  };

  const getHeaderSet = (h) => {
    if (!_headerSet && h) _headerSet = new Set([h, ...h.querySelectorAll("*")]);
    return _headerSet ?? new Set();
  };

  const hasSkipClass = (el) => {
    for (const c of el.classList) if (SKIP_CLASSES.has(c)) return true;
    return false;
  };

  const getHeaderBackground = () => {
    const h = getHeader();
    const rect = h?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = innerWidth / 2;
    const y = rect ? rect.bottom - 1 : 10;

    for (const img of document.querySelectorAll(
      ".product-media.djdksan img, .trending-image-wrapper img"
    )) {
      const b = img.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (
        b.right > 0 && b.left < innerWidth &&
        b.top <= (rect?.bottom ?? 60) && b.bottom >= (rect?.top ?? 0) &&
        img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0
      ) {
        const br = getImageBrightness(img);
        if (br !== null) {
          return `rgb(${Math.round(br)},${Math.round(br)},${Math.round(br)})`;
        }
      }
    }

    const hSet = getHeaderSet(h);
    for (const el of document.elementsFromPoint(x, y)) {
      if (hSet.has(el) || hasSkipClass(el)) continue;

      if (el.tagName === "IMG") {
        const br = getImageBrightness(el);
        if (br !== null) {
          return `rgb(${Math.round(br)},${Math.round(br)},${Math.round(br)})`;
        }
        continue;
      }

      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      const bg = cs.backgroundColor;
      if (bg && bg !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)") {
        const a = parseFloat(bg.match(/[\d.]+/g)?.[3] ?? "1");
        if (a >= 0.2) return bg;
      }
      if (cs.backgroundImage !== "none") return "rgb(0,0,0)";
    }

    return "rgb(255,255,255)";
  };

  let lastHeaderBgCls = null;
  const lastIconCls = new WeakMap();

  const update = () => {
    const h = getHeader();
    const bg = getHeaderBackground();
    const br = getBrightness(bg);
    const cls = br > 140 ? "bg-light" : "bg-dark";

    if (h && cls !== lastHeaderBgCls) {
      h.classList.toggle("bg-dark", cls === "bg-dark");
      h.classList.toggle("bg-light", cls === "bg-light");
      lastHeaderBgCls = cls;
      _headerSet = null;
    }

    if (h) {
      h.querySelectorAll(
        ".svg-wrapper, .icon-share, .header-logo__image-container"
      ).forEach(el => {
        if (lastIconCls.get(el) === cls) return;
        el.classList.remove("bg-light", "bg-dark");
        el.classList.add(cls);
        lastIconCls.set(el, cls);
      });
    }
  };

  // ── Per-card theming ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const applyCardTheme = (card) => {
    const img = card.querySelector(
      ".product-media.djdksan img, .trending-image-wrapper img"
    );
    const targets = card.querySelectorAll(".CUSTOM-BADGE, .trending-badge");
    if (!img || !targets.length) return;

    

    const apply = (trigger) => {
      const br = getImageBrightness(img);
      if (br === null) {
        if (DEBUG) console.warn("⚠️ brightness null — CORS or decode issue. crossOrigin attr:", img.getAttribute("crossorigin"));
        if (DEBUG) console.groupEnd();
        return;
      }
      const cls = br > 100 ? "bg-light" : "bg-dark";
      targets.forEach(el => {
        if (el.dataset.lastBg === cls) {
          return;
        }
        el.classList.remove("bg-light", "bg-dark");
        el.classList.add(cls);
        el.dataset.lastBg = cls;
      });
      
    };

    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
      apply("immediate");
    } else {
      if (DEBUG) console.log("→ img not ready, waiting for load event");
    }
    img.addEventListener("load", () => apply("load event"), { once: true });

    if (DEBUG && !(img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0)) console.groupEnd();
  };

  // ── Product page complementary btn (no .product-card wrapper) ────────────
const initProductPageComplementaryBtns = () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".product-card__complementary-btn").forEach(btn => {
    // Already handled by processCard (inside a card)
    if (btn.closest(".product-card, .trending-product-card")) return;

    // On product page: btn and img share a li.product-media-container parent
    const scope = btn.closest("li") ?? btn.parentElement;
    const img = scope?.querySelector(".product-media.djdksan img");
    if (!img) return;

    const apply = () => {
      const br = getImageBrightness(img);
      if (br === null) return;
      const cls = br > 100 ? "bg-light" : "bg-dark";
      if (btn.dataset.lastBg === cls) return;
      btn.classList.remove("bg-light", "bg-dark");
      btn.classList.add(cls);
      btn.dataset.lastBg = cls;
    };

    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) apply();
    img.addEventListener("load", apply, { once: true });
  });
};

  const applyComplementaryBtn = (card) => {
    const img = card.querySelector(".product-media.djdksan img");
    const btn = card.querySelector(".product-card__complementary-btn");
    if (!img || !btn) return;

    const apply = (trigger) => {
      const br = getImageBrightness(img);
      if (br === null) {
        if (DEBUG) console.warn("⚠️ complementaryBtn brightness null");
        return;
      }
      const cls = br > 100 ? "bg-light" : "bg-dark";
      if (btn.dataset.lastBg === cls) return;
      btn.classList.remove("bg-light", "bg-dark");
      btn.classList.add(cls);
      btn.dataset.lastBg = cls;
    };

    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) apply("immediate");
    img.addEventListener("load", () => apply("load event"), { once: true });
  };

  const processCard = (card) => {
    applyCardTheme(card);
    applyComplementaryBtn(card);
  };

  // ── MutationObserver ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const cardObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
    for (const m of mutations) {
      for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
        if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
        if (node.matches?.(".product-card, .trending-product-card")) {
          processCard(node);
        } else {
          node.querySelectorAll?.(".product-card, .trending-product-card")
            .forEach(processCard);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  let scrollTimer = null;
  const onScroll = () => {
    clearTimeout(scrollTimer);
    scrollTimer = setTimeout(update, 120);
  };


 const updateSoldOutSwatchStrokes = (root = document) => {
  root.querySelectorAll(".variant-option__strikethrough").forEach(svg => {
    const label = svg.closest("label");
    // Adjust the selector to whatever your 'swatch' snippet outputs
    const swatch = label?.querySelector(".swatch, [class*='swatch']:not(label)");
    if (!swatch) return;

    const cs = getComputedStyle(swatch);
    let brightness = null;

    // Solid color
    const m = cs.backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g);
    if (m && m.length >= 3 && (m.length < 4 || Number(m[3]) > 0.1)) {
      brightness = (m[0] * 299 + m[1] * 587 + m[2] * 114) / 1000;
    }

    // Image swatch: sample the <img> if there is one
    if (brightness === null) {
      const img = swatch.matches("img") ? swatch : swatch.querySelector("img");
      if (img?.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
        brightness = getImageBrightness(img);
      } else if (img) {
        img.addEventListener("load", () => updateSoldOutSwatchStrokes(label.parentElement), { once: true });
      }
    }

    if (brightness === null) return;
    svg.classList.toggle("invert-stroke", brightness < 140);
  });
};


 const init = () => {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    update();
    updateSoldOutSwatchStrokes();
    document.querySelectorAll(".product-card, .trending-product-card").forEach(processCard);
    initProductPageComplementaryBtns(); // ← add this

    document.querySelectorAll(
      ".product-media.djdksan img, .trending-image-wrapper img"
    ).forEach(img => {
      if (!img.complete) {
        img.addEventListener(
          "load",
          () => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(update)),

document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

  // Only run on touch devices
  if (!window.matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)').matches) return;

  const target = e.target.closest(
    'a[href], button, [role="button"], input[type="button"], input[type="submit"], .btn'
  );

  if (!target) return;

  // Don't ripple disabled elements
  if (target.disabled || target.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;

  // Add container class if missing
  if (!target.classList.contains('ripple-container')) {
    target.classList.add('ripple-container');
  }

  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();

  const ripple = document.createElement('span');
  ripple.classList.add('ripple');

  const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);

  ripple.style.width = ripple.style.height = size + 'px';

  const x = e.clientX - rect.left - size / 2;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top - size / 2;

  ripple.style.left = x + 'px';
  ripple.style.top = y + 'px';

  target.appendChild(ripple);

  setTimeout(() => {
    ripple.remove();
  }, 600);

});

<script>
(function () {
  var SEL = '#custom-gc-container-drawer';
  var isOpen = false;
  var userClosed = false;
  var queued = false;

  var SVG = function (paths) {
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' + paths + '</svg>';
  };
  var GIFT = SVG('<rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 8v13M12 8c-2-4-6-3-5 0 .5 1.3 3 1 5 0zm0 0c2-4 6-3 5 0-.5 1.3-3 1-5 0z"/>');
  var PLUS = SVG('<path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>');
  var X = SVG('<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/>');

  function toggleOf(c) {
    var t = c.previousElementSibling;
    return t && t.classList.contains('gk-toggle') ? t : null;
  }

  function apply(c) {
    c.classList.toggle('gk-open', isOpen);
    var t = toggleOf(c);
    if (t) {
      t.hidden = isOpen;
      t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
    }
  }

  function enhance() {
    queued = false;
    var c = document.querySelector(SEL);
    if (!c) return;

    var input = c.querySelector('.egift_card');
    if (input && input.value && !userClosed) isOpen = true;


    if (!toggleOf(c)) {
      var t = document.createElement('button');
      t.type = 'button';
      t.className = 'gk-toggle';
      t.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'custom-gc-container-drawer');
      t.innerHTML = GIFT + '<span>Have a Giftkarte?</span>' + PLUS;
      c.parentNode.insertBefore(t, c);
    }

    if (!c.querySelector('.gk-close')) {
      var x = document.createElement('button');
      x.type = 'button';
      x.className = 'gk-close';
      x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close gift card field');
      x.innerHTML = X;
      c.appendChild(x);
    }
    c.classList.add('gk-ready');
    apply(c);
  }

  function queue() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(enhance);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var open = e.target.closest('.gk-toggle');
    var close = e.target.closest('.gk-close');
    if (!open && !close) return;
    var c = document.querySelector(SEL);
    if (!c) return;
    isOpen = !!open;
    userClosed = !!close;     // add this
    apply(c);
    if (isOpen) {
      var i = c.querySelector('.egift_card');
      if (i) i.focus();
    } else {
      var t = toggleOf(c);
      if (t) t.focus();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' || !isOpen) return;
    var c = document.querySelector(SEL);
    if (c && c.contains(e.target)) {
      isOpen = false;
      apply(c);
      var t = toggleOf(c);
      if (t) t.focus();
    }
  });

  new MutationObserver(queue).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  queue();
})();
</script>

# Agent Instructions — ZELLBURY

You can browse products and shop at ZELLBURY's online store, https://zellbury.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://zellbury.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://zellbury.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://zellbury.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/refund-policy
- **Shipping policy**: https://zellbury.com/policies/shipping-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: this document (`/agents.md`) is the canonical agent-facing description of the store.
